title: Source requirements
summary: Checks on the message received, before any rule runs.

sections.title: Requirements
paragraphs: A destination can require that the message received fits what its rules assume. Number of records counts a record or segment, such as OBR, against a minimum and a maximum. Same value in every record needs every occurrence of a path, such as OBR.3.1, to hold the same text; a missing value counts as empty. Checks run in order before any rule.

A message that fails a check fails only this destination's mapping with a transform error that names the check and the reason, never the value. It is kept, and nothing is filtered. Fix the message source or the mapping, then resend.

sections.title: Several patients or orders
paragraphs: Refuse messages with several patients or orders fails a message that holds more than one patient, order or specimen group. Use it for result conversions with calculations or appended records, which could otherwise place a value under the wrong sample. An order sent to an instrument for one specimen with several orders needs Number of records and Same value checks instead.

sections.title: Presets
paragraphs: A mapping preset adds its rules and the requirements they assume after your own. A table you already have under the same name is kept. Replace is a separate choice and the dialog says what goes.
